name: HealPad
brief: A damage and heal room: a floor with a SpawnLocation, a spike strip that hurts (20 damage per touch, at most once per second), and a heal pad that restores full health.
contract: The spike strip is a Part named Spikes (it damages but does not kill instantly); the heal pad is a Part named HealPad.
leaderstats IntValue named Heals starting at 0: each time the heal pad heals a hurt player, add 1 Heals (debounced per player, at most once per 2 seconds).
